Hi Sarah,

Thanks for the quick intake form — to accelerate the SOC 2 / SIG review we need a narrowly scoped set of access artifacts so our audit team can validate provisioning and least-privilege controls. Can you help with the following items by EOD Thursday (Feb 24)?

1) A SCIM delta export that includes: users, groups, group-membership, and externalMappings over the past 30 days. A CSV excerpt (first 200 rows) is fine for initial triage.
2) SAML assertion samples (raw HTTP-POST) for three representative user sign-ins and one service account SSO flow. We only need the base64-decoded assertion text with timestamps redacted.
3) A short "privileged roles" matrix (who can assign role X, who can escalate, approval channel). If you already have an RBAC spreadsheet, a copy will work.
4) Confirmation of SCIM provisioning mode (push pull), and whether SCIM delta includes soft-deletes or tombstones.

If there's a security channel or SFTP location you'd prefer for sensitive exports, point us at it and we will use the secure upload. If you want, we can accept a minimal sample first (items 1+2) and then intake the full delta.

Thanks — I'll loop in our engineering folks internally for the mapping.

Best,
Laura Bennett
